content.title: Carvana, Robinhood, Coinbase: The 3 biggest turnarounds from 2022
content.description:
Carvana (CVNA), Robinhood Markets (HOOD), and Coinbase Global (COIN) have two main themes in common as 2025 draws to a close: all three are the latest additions to the S&P 500 (^GSPC) this year, and they were the biggest market losers in 2022. Carvana will be joining the market index on Monday, December 22.

Yahoo Finance senior markets reporter Ines Ferré outlines each of the three companies' most pivotal moments in their turnarounds from 2022 lows.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.

Strategy Keeps Nasdaq 100 Listing; What It Means For Bitcoin
content.summary: Strategy, the bitcoin-holding company, remains part of the Nasdaq 100 index after the annual reconstitution announced Friday evening.  MSCI is considering whether to exclude companies whose primary business is acquiring bitcoin or other cryptocurrencies from its indices.  Nasdaq didn't indicate that it is reviewing whether Strategy still meets the criteria for the Nasdaq 100, which comprises the exchange's largest nonfinancial firms.
